items: 【Practical Lift Top Design】The coffee table experiences smooth and safe lifting with a high-quality lifting mechanism featuring gas struts. Raise the top of this coffee table from 19.7 inches to 25.4 inches and make it easy to work from home, enjoy a meal, do crafts, or play games while sitting comfortably on your couch.

【Spacious Storage】This coffee table features a hidden storage compartment under the lift top, keeping all your living room essentials close at hand while keeping clutter at bay. The coffee table's 4 open compartments each feature removable, adjustable shelves (3 height adjustable), allowing you to customize your storage space.

【Upgrade Design】High quality lift top mechanism enables the tabletop to be lifted up or lowered down effortlessly and noiselessly, Children don't have to worry about hurting their fingers when using. With solid construction and selected materials, this coffee table will not wobble if correctly assembled.

【Farmhouse Coffee Table】The tabletop and frame of this coffee table are made from FSC-certified wood. The tabletop is waterproof and scratch-resistant, making it more durable than ordinary coffee tables. Square coffee table can complement any modern or rustic rooms, highlighting your personal taste and ideals. The unique square shape is just the right size to not only complement your sofa well but also fit well in both small and large spaces.

【Easy Assemble & After-sales Service】To make assembling this sturdy coffee table as effortless as possible, we have included clear and detailed instructions, and numbered parts. If your coffee table arrives damaged, scratched, or missing part, please feel free to contact us, we will send you a free replacement or offer a partial refund.
